user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's birthday and I want to make it extra special. Can you suggest some unique party games and provide interesting trivia about the birthday boy? Also, find me some chuck jokes to add laughter to the celebration.

TaskList.description: Gather unique party game suggestions suitable for a birthday celebration.
Collect interesting trivia about the birthday boy based on his interests and background.
Find a selection of chuck jokes to incorporate humor into the party.
